signIn.title: Sign in to your account
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Use your work email or a connected provider.
signIn.getOneTimeLink: Or get a one-time sign-in link →
signIn.magicLinkSent: Magic sign-in link sent to {{email}}. Check your inbox to continue.
signIn.lockedOut: Too many incorrect attempts — locked out for 60s.
signIn.wrongPassword_one: Wrong password. {{count}} attempt left before lockout.
signIn.wrongPassword_other: Wrong password. {{count}} attempts left before lockout.
signIn.ssoEnterEmail: Enter your work email to continue with SSO.
signIn.ssoNotConfigured: No SSO is configured for this domain — use your password instead.

lockout.title: Account temporarily locked
lockout.body: Too many incorrect password attempts. You can try again in
lockout.bodyRest: , or use SSO / a magic link instead.

ssoEnforced.title: {{org}} requires SSO
ssoEnforced.body: Password sign-in is disabled for your organization. You'll be redirected to <0>{{provider}}</0>.

demo.label: Demo:
demo.body: password is <0>sefield-demo</0>. Try <1>user@acme.com</1> to see SSO enforcement, or any email containing <2>magic</2> for the magic-link branch. Three wrong passwords trigger lockout.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Start with a free workspace. You can invite teammates next.
signUp.footer: Free for individuals · Team plan starts at $20/seat/mo
signUp.emailInvalid: Use a complete email like name@company.com

terms.rest: . I understand this app indexes my code and my AI usage may be billed.

ssoOrg.title: {{org}} uses SSO
ssoOrg.subtitle: Your organization manages accounts through their identity provider, so there's no separate signup.
ssoOrg.signInWith: Sign in with your <0>{{domain}}</0> credentials — we'll create your se · field account on the way.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.subtitle: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Click it to finish setting up your account.
sent.resend: Resend or use a different email

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email associated with your account. If it exists, we'll send a link to reset your password.
forgot.signInWithSsoLink: you may want to sign in with SSO

throttled.title: Too many reset requests
throttled.subtitle: For security, we've paused reset requests from this device. Try again later or contact your admin.
throttled.bannerBody: We allow up to 5 reset requests per hour per device. This protects your account from spam attacks.

idpManaged.title: Password reset is managed by your IdP
idpManaged.subtitle: {{org}} uses {{provider}} for sign-in, so passwords are managed there.
idpManaged.bannerBody: Use {{provider}} or your IT admin's self-service portal. After resetting, sign back in here with SSO.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.subtitle: If an account exists for {{email}}, we've sent a password reset link. The link expires in 30 minutes.
sent.subjectFrom: Subject: <0>"Reset your se · field password"</0> · From: <1>noreply@se-field.app</1>
sent.line2: The link is valid for 30 minutes
sent.line3: Single-use — clicking it again does nothing
sent.line4: Didn't arrive? Check spam, then resend.
sent.securityNote: For security, we always show this screen — even if no account exists for <0>{{email}}</0>. That way attackers can't use this form to discover registered emails.

forgot.privacyNote: We never reveal whether an email is registered. Up to 5 reset requests per hour, per device.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick something you haven't used here before. We'll sign out other sessions for security.
reset.signOutNotice: For your security, we'll sign you out everywhere else and require 2FA again on this browser.

expired.title: This link expired
expired.subtitle: Reset links are valid for 30 minutes. Request a fresh one to continue.
expired.body: For your security, password reset links can only be used once and expire quickly.

success.title: Password updated
success.subtitle: You're all set. We've signed out other sessions and reset your trusted devices.
success.autoRedirectCanceled: Auto-redirect canceled. Click the button above to continue.

mfa.title: Two-factor verification
mfa.subtitleMock: One more step. We need to confirm it's really you.
mfa.subtitleReal: One more step. Enter the code from your authenticator.
mfa.trustDeviceNote: We'll skip 2FA on this browser. Don't enable on shared computers.

lowBackup.title: Code accepted — 2 backup codes remaining
lowBackup.body: You're running low. Generate a fresh set now and store them somewhere safe.

totp.label: Enter the 6-digit code from your app
totp.demo: Demo: code is <0>{{code}}</0>. Try anything else to see the wrong-code state.

backup.label: Backup code
backup.hint: Each backup code can only be used once. Find them in your authenticator settings.

webauthn.touch: Touch your security key or authenticator
webauthn.compatible: Compatible: Touch ID · Windows Hello · YubiKey · Apple Passkey

backupCodes.title: Save your backup codes
backupCodes.subtitle: If you lose access to your authenticator, these are the only way back in. Each code works once.
backupCodes.footer: We won't show these again. Save them now.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has ended
sessionExpired.subtitle: For your security, we sign you out after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue where you left off.
sessionExpired.signInDifferentUser: Sign in as a different user

reason.idleSubtitle: You were inactive for over 8 hours.
reason.manualSubtitle: You signed out from another device.
reason.adminRevokedSubtitle: An administrator ended this session — usually due to a security review.
reason.inactiveMfaSubtitle: Your trusted device window expired. We need 2FA again.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.subtitle: We'll route you to your organization's identity provider.
sso.enterHint: We'll discover your identity provider once you start typing your domain.
sso.passwordDisabled: · Password sign-in disabled for this domain
sso.notConfiguredBody: Either it's a different domain, or your admin hasn't set up an identity provider.
sso.setUpSso: Set up SSO for your org

subtitle.verifying: This usually takes a couple of seconds.
subtitle.success: You can now access your workspace and invite teammates.
subtitle.expired: Verification links are valid for 24 hours. Request a fresh one to continue.
subtitle.reused: This link has been used to verify another session. Each link only works once.
subtitle.wasntMe: Thanks for letting us know. We have invalidated the verification request.

wasntMe.title: Token has been revoked.
wasntMe.loggedAt: We logged this incident at <0>{{time}}</0>. If your password may have been compromised, change it now.

acceptInvitation.title: Join the organization
acceptInvitation.subtitle: Accepting your invitation to collaborate.
acceptInvitation.missingToken: This invitation link is missing its token.
acceptInvitation.success: You're in. Your access to the organization is active.
acceptInvitation.errorSuffix: It may have expired, been revoked, or already been used.

oauthOverlay.redirectingBody: Opening their secure sign-in page in this window.
oauthOverlay.onProviderBody: Approve the request on {{provider}} to come back here.
oauthOverlay.returningBody: Validating the response and signing you in.
oauthOverlay.cancel: Cancel and use a different method
